response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced software engineer with a strong track record in full-stack development, distributed systems, and technical mentorship. However, he falls significantly short of the core technical requirements for this role, most notably the minimum of 8 years of C++ programming experience, as he only has a few months of professional exposure to C++. Additionally, his background leans heavily toward web applications and product development rather than the deep, low-level cloud compute infrastructure and hardware architecture required to lead this specific platform.
strengths: Demonstrated technical leadership and mentorship through organizing workshops, code katas, and teaching software courses.
Extensive experience with software design, architecture, and engineering best practices like TDD and CI/CD.
Proven ability to build and maintain distributed systems and high-throughput microservices.
concerns: Critically lacks the required 8 years of C++ programming experience, having only about 6 months of professional exposure.
Primary expertise lies in web and full-stack development rather than low-level cloud compute technologies and hardware architecture.
Limited experience specifically leading internal cloud compute platforms powering downstream product engineering.
